description: Floating toolbar for a selected image offering alt-text, caption, replace, and delete actions, a seven-mode text-wrap control, and (for non-inline modes) horizontal position, edge-distance fields, an anchor lock, and a more-options button.

parameters.name: CurrentWrapMode
parameters.description: Current text wrapping mode for the selected image.

parameters.name: CurrentHorizontalPosition
parameters.description: Current text wrapping mode for the selected image.

parameters.name: DistanceBottom
parameters.description: Current top text distance around the image.

parameters.name: DistanceLeft
parameters.description: Current horizontal position for non-inline image wrapping.

parameters.name: DistanceRight
parameters.description: Current left text distance around the image.

parameters.name: DistanceTop
parameters.description: Current right text distance around the image.

parameters.name: LockAnchor
parameters.description: Current bottom text distance around the image.

parameters.name: OnAltTextRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the image anchor lock changes.

parameters.name: OnCaptionToggle
parameters.description: Raised when the alt text action is requested.

parameters.name: OnDelete
parameters.description: Raised when the replace image action is requested.

parameters.name: OnDistanceBottomChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the top text distance changes.

parameters.name: OnDistanceLeftChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the image horizontal position changes.

parameters.name: OnDistanceRightChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the left text distance changes.

parameters.name: OnDistanceTopChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the right text distance changes.

parameters.name: OnHorizontalPositionChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the image wrap mode changes.

parameters.name: OnLockAnchorChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the bottom text distance changes.

parameters.name: OnMoreOptionsRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the delete image action is requested.

parameters.name: OnReplaceRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the caption toggle is requested.

parameters.name: OnWrapModeChanged
parameters.description: Whether the selected image anchor is locked.
